body:
Restore the root suite after stale law bindings and an oversized portable package broke main at `b9cafd196b1d8f8b74b207320836532c14e78bab`. Step 1 of [#1538](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/issues/1538) repairs the corpus, package and affected tests together. The baseline had 1,853 root tests, 19 failures and 11 errors; its full run passed 33 of 35 checks.

## Repair

- Relocate all four unchanged reviewed law slices by 4,412 bytes under the selected `absolute-refresh` design. Preserve their meanings and the v1 codec, review the three local profiles, and acquire complete new 10-call measurement and 36-call parity records. Preserve the refused first parity cohort.
- Omit 32 decorative portraits from generated copies and repair 47 packaged Markdown image references. All 34 source portraits remain. The manifest records omissions and exact removed byte ranges; eleven unchanged prompts permit owner replay of historical evaluation answers with their original model and date. That replay makes no new model observation.
- Enforce a minimum 5,242,880-byte reserve below the fixed 26,214,400-byte cap. The complete package is 18,668,573 bytes across 1,402 files, leaving 7,545,827 bytes of headroom; the runtime is 18,239,372 bytes across 1,395 files.
- Repair #1520's test to check `run_observation_binding.controller` and the six current runtime test-source bindings separately. Give #1542's two CLI tests their own candidate records and source copies. Production fallback for unrelated live Fiat records is inherited.

The [recovery README](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/blob/c7db7d734fad5ab40511ae04cbb8a6c43aefb824/docs/main-root-suite-recovery/README.md) preserves reproduction, profile review, source recovery and evidence limits. The package decision remains `adr/omit-portable-decorative-portraits`; final integration assigns its ADR number.

## Validation

Implementation commit `0578c19bb812ba34fcfc752dcb81e5df4b1090ae` passed 1,882 active root tests, 2,615 Hexaemeron tests, the 403-test focused runner and all 35 declared checks with 12 workers.

[Independent audit PR #1549](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1549) preserves signed audit commit `540ebaf014982683816225c8c1933f023deb4c76` and the [audit log](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/blob/540ebaf014982683816225c8c1933f023deb4c76/audit/rounds/fiat-1538-restore-main-root-suite-green-and-enforce-m.md). Warden independently passed 1,882 active root tests, 403 focused tests, Phylax, Ephoros, Hypomnema and the study bridge, then all 35 declared checks. Findings: 0; fixes: none; Elenchus verdict: `null`. The audit PR's hosted `invariants` check passed.

The delivery branch carries the identical checked tree `d83c77fa35b332592f9a44187a883619b415de0d` in distinct signed record-only commit `c7db7d734fad5ab40511ae04cbb8a6c43aefb824`. The review PR remains unmerged.

Run from a clean committed checkout with Python 3.14.6:

```bash
uv run --no-project --python 3.14.6 python scripts/agent_instruction.py check --root . --manifest tests/fixtures/agent-instruction-v1/manifest.json
uv run --no-project --python 3.14.6 python tests/emit_main_root_recovery_report.py .elenchus/main-root-recovery.json
uv run --no-project --python 3.14.6 python -m unittest discover -s tests
uv run --no-project --python 3.14.6 python plugins/hexaemeron/tests/run_tests.py
uv run --no-project --python 3.14.6 python scripts/run_checks.py --full --jobs 12 --format json --report .hexaemeron/step-1-checks.json
```

## Evidence limits and remaining work

Warden's candidate-fixture bypass probe stayed green because the inherited fallback handles unrelated live records; this step claims no new behavioural guard for that isolation. Warden reviewed the model records offline and made no fresh model calls or independent token-count assertion; [#1199](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/issues/1199) retains that limit.

[#1513](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/issues/1513) remains open for reusable reconciliation after this immediate corpus repair. [#1192](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/issues/1192) remains open for the relative-offset schema. [#1467](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/issues/1467)'s implementation acceptance was independently verified; closure follows final integration. [PR #1515](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1515) remains a separate specification. Step 2 owns GitHub merge enforcement and final main CI evidence.

## Stack

Base: `fiat/1538-restore-main-root-suite-green-and-enforce-m` at `b9cafd196b1d8f8b74b207320836532c14e78bab`.
Head: `fiat/1538-restore-main-root-suite-green-and-enforce-m-step-1-scaffold-recovery-and-restore-al`.
This first step targets the run branch. The stack remains open until final integration.
